# Data Residency — Claude Skills Factory + CodeDocs

## Where Data Lives / Onde os Dados Ficam

### Skills (instruction files)
| Data | Location | Evidence |
|------|----------|----------|
| SKILL.md files | GitHub (github.com) | Public repo, MIT license |
| User's source code | Sent to Anthropic API via Claude Code | Anthropic's data handling policy applies |
| Generated docs | User's local machine | Written to docs/ directory |

### CodeDocs (offline CLI)
| Data | Location | Evidence |
|------|----------|----------|
| User's source code | **Never leaves the machine** | scanner.py uses local grep/find/git only |
| Scan results | Local memory (Python dict) | Never written to disk except as HTML output |
| HTML output | `codedocs-output/` on user's machine | Local files only |
| No cloud storage | — | Zero network calls |
| No external processing | — | Zero API calls |

## Data Flow Diagram

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│           USER'S MACHINE (100% local)        │
│                                              │
│  Source Code ──→ grep/find/git ──→ Python    │
│                  (pattern match)    dict     │
│                                      │       │
│                                      ▼       │
│                              HTML files      │
│                         (codedocs-output/)    │
│                                              │
│  ❌ No data leaves this box with CodeDocs    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## International Transfers / Transferências Internacionais

- **CodeDocs**: No international transfers — zero network calls
- **Skills via Claude Code**: Data sent to Anthropic (US-based) — subject to Anthropic's DPA
- **GitHub**: Repository hosted on GitHub (US-based, Microsoft) — public repo, no sensitive data

## LGPD / GDPR Compliance

- **CodeDocs processes zero personal data** — it scans source code patterns, not user data
- **No cookies, no tracking, no analytics, no user accounts**
- **[MANUAL]**: If used as a service (SaaS future), LGPD/GDPR compliance would need reassessment
